plain_english_policy: Support contracting with private sector firms to build and/or manage state prisons.

effects.rationale: Contracting with private sector firms may lead to reduced labor costs and increased efficiency, potentially reducing the financial burden on taxpayers.
Private sector firms are often more capital-efficient than government-run prisons. This could lead to reduced costs and improved resource allocation for other welfare programs.

evidence_quote: "Support contracting with private sector firms to build and/or manage state prisons." - Source: Year: 2002, Section: Crime Issues, Question: Indicate which principles you support (if any) to address crime. Option: b)
review_reason: The policy statement is specific but the effects on labor and capital are speculative.
